checks.detail: T10 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (six t10 evidence files, campaign_invocation_binding.py, campaign_controller.py, and the two owned test modules), forbids every other campaign/control-plane module, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, strategy, requirements, and non-owned tests; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All twenty-two input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, T1 through T9 task reports/validations/completions, plus the T8/T9 task reports and completions; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source changes are campaign_controller.py and tests/test_control_plane_campaign_controller.py, with campaign_invocation_binding.py and tests/test_control_plane_campaign_invocation_binding.py added; data, KBase, strategy, policy, scheduler/ACL, user files, and all other control-plane modules are untouched.

campaign_invocation_binding.py freezes provider_profile_id, provider/model identity, pricing snapshot, logical retry policy, and the live spawn ProcessIdentity into one canonical TrustedInvocationBinding payload with a deterministic invocation_binding_sha256; invalid identifiers, non-hex digests, negative/absent pricing, out-of-range retry bounds, missing limit fields, and non-identity providers fail closed; require_provider_binding rejects drifted or incomplete provider identity, verify_spawn_identity rejects process drift, and construct_provider refuses construction except from a validated binding.

invoke_member_json now calls require_invocation_binding (profile + pricing + retry + spawn identity + provider identity) before any provider executor construction, and re-verifies the live spawn identity immediately before SpawnedProviderExecutor(provider); the previous inline provider-identity tuple check was replaced by the canonical binding gate.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read or update, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started; the new module performs no I/O, no subprocesses, and no provider SDK imports.

advisories.detail: The binding sha256 is computed by the module and exercised by tests, but is not yet embedded in the operational model-call event schema (v2 preserved for replay compatibility); persisting the binding identity belongs to later composition slices.

The controller still receives the provider object from callers; construct_provider is the module-level construction gate for adapter factories, while the controller enforces binding before executor construction. A factory-based injection path may be composed in a later slice.
